title: 45 MINUTES MOST POWERFUL PSALM 120 MORNING PRAYER TO START YOUR DAY
text: I want somebody to say it out loud before we do anything else. I did not come here by accident. There is a reason this title found you tonight. Somewhere in this gathering is a person who has quietly suspected for a long time that not everything working against them is natural. You have prayed, you have fasted, you have done everything you know to do, and still there is a resistance that meets you at every door, the same door, the same pattern, the same wall. No matter how many times you try a different approach, I speak to that suspicion right now. You are not paranoid, you are not being dramatic, there is an assignment, and tonight it ends. We are not here to have a nice service, we are here to fight. Not with our hands, not with human strategy, but with the kind of authority heaven issued to the church the day the veil tore from top to bottom. Somebody lift your voice and let this building hear you. I decree war. Before we go further, let's get one thing settled in the spirit, because war language makes some people uncomfortable, as if faith and warfare cannot occupy the same sentence. Second Corinthians chapter 10 verse 4 tells us plainly, for the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds. Church, you were never called to a passive Christianity that simply endures whatever comes. You were called into an active, aggressive, authoritative relationship with a God who identifies himself in Exodus chapter 15 verse 3 as a man of war. If God himself carries that title, then his children were never meant to be pacifists in the face of hell's agenda against their lives. Let that settle in you. The same God who split a sea to deliver Israel and drowned the army pursuing them did not retire from warfare after the Old Testament closed. He simply changed the battlefield from the Red Sea to the unseen realm, from Pharaoh's chariots to principalities and powers. Ephesians chapter 6 verse 12 tells us exactly where the real fight is located. For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. Somebody has been fighting a human being, a boss, an in-law, a rival, a former friend when the actual architecture behind your frustration was never human at all. Tonight, we redirect our fire to the correct target. I feel something rising already. Let the fire of God fall on every misdirected battle in this house. Every energy you have wasted fighting a person instead of a spirit, I redirect it now in the name of Jesus. Let's talk about assignments because that word is central to tonight's charge, and I do not want anybody here to misunderstand what an assignment actually is. An assignment is not random misfortune. It is a targeted, deliberate, structured plan with a beginning, an objective, and often a deadline designed by an intelligence in the spirit realm to hinder, delay, distort, or destroy something specific in your life. Job understood this. In Job chapter 3, after everything was stripped from him, he said something that reveals just how targeted spiritual attack can be. For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me. That is not the language of coincidence. That is the testimony of a man who recognized that fear itself can become a doorway an assignment walks through. I speak to every open door in your life created by fear. Every door you open by dwelling on your worst-case scenario until it became a spiritual invitation, I shut that door now in the name of Jesus. Church, hear me. An assignment against your life does not always look dramatic. Sometimes it looks like chronic fatigue that no doctor can explain. Sometimes it looks like a business that should be thriving by every natural metric but keeps stalling at the exact same revenue point. Sometimes it looks like a relationship pattern where every promising connection dies at the same stage as if there is an invisible wall at that exact point in every story. If that is your testimony, I want you to understand tonight you are not unlucky. You are not cursed by fate. You are targeted and targeted people serve a God who specializes in dismantling targets. Somebody shout canceled. Say it like you mean it because tonight is not a night for polite prayer. Isaiah 54:17 is not a suggestion. It is a covenant declaration. No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper. And every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shall condemn. Notice the verse does not promise that no weapon will be formed. Weapons will be formed. The promise is that they will not prosper. Let that distinction free you tonight. The absence of attack was never the promise. The certainty of victory over every attack is the promise. I decree over somebody's life right now. Every weapon currently in formation against your health, your marriage, your finances, your children, your ministry is disassembled before it can be launched in the name of Jesus. Let's go deeper into the mechanics of cancellation because canceling an assignment is a legal transaction in the spirit realm, not just an emotional outburst. Colossians chapter 2:15 describes what Christ accomplished at the cross in language that should make every believer stand taller. "And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it." The word spoiled there means stripped, disarmed, publicly humiliated. Jesus did not simply defeat the powers of darkness in a private quiet victory. He paraded them openly as a conquered enemy on display. Whatever authority the enemy claims to have over your life today is authority he does not legitimately possess anymore. He's operating on documents that were nullified 2,000 years ago, hoping you never find out the paperwork changed. Tonight, we're not begging God for a victory that has not happened yet. We are enforcing a victory that has already been won. That is the difference between religious prayer and prophetic warfare. Religious prayer says, "God, please help me win." Prophetic warfare says, "It is already won. I now enforce the verdict." Somebody say it with authority. It is already won. I am not fighting for victory. I am fighting from victory. Let the declarations begin to rise now because teaching alone will not deliver anybody tonight. I decree that every demonic assignment carrying your name, your photograph, your date of birth, or any personal item taken from you without your knowledge is canceled by fire in the name of Jesus. Every satanic file opened against your destiny burn now. Every meeting convened in the dark to discuss your downfall be scattered by the thunder of God in the name of Jesus. Let's look at Numbers chapter 23:23 because Balaam's story is one of the clearest pictures in scripture of an assignment that could not land. Balak hired Balaam specifically to curse Israel offering money, prestige, and pressure to get him to speak against God's people. And after multiple attempts, the spirit forced these words out of Balaam's own mouth. Surely, there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel. Church, understand what happened here? A professional curse caller hired at great expense opened his mouth to curse God's covenant people and blessing came out instead. The assignment was real. The money was real. The intent was real. But the covering over Israel was more real than all of it combined. I decree that same reversal over every curse assigned against you tonight. Whatever the enemy hired someone or something to speak against you, let it turn to blessing in the mouth that tries to release it in the name of Jesus. There is a category of assignment that operates through delay rather than destruction, and I want to address it directly because it is subtle and many believers miss it entirely. Not every attack is designed to end your life or bankrupt you outright. Some attacks are designed simply to make you late, late to the marriage that was meant for your 20s, late to the business breakthrough that was meant for your 30s, late to the healing that should have come the week you first prayed for it. Daniel chapter 10 gives us the clearest biblical picture of this. Daniel prayed and received no visible answer for 21 days. And when the angel finally arrived, he explained why. The prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me 1 and 20 days. The answer was released the moment Daniel prayed. The delay was not God's silence. It was resistance in the unseen realm. I speak to every 21-day, 21-month, or 21-year delay operating in somebody's life tonight. Whatever principality has been standing between the day you prayed and the day your answer was scheduled to arrive, I command reinforcement from heaven right now. In the name of Jesus, let Michael arise. Let every hindering prince fall back in the name of Jesus. Somebody has been told, directly or indirectly, that they are simply unlucky, that some people just don't get breaks, that some families just don't prosper, that some bodies just don't heal easily. I renounce that language over your life tonight. >> [music] >> Deuteronomy chapter 28:7 declares, "The Lord shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face. They shall come out against thee one way and flee before thee seven ways." That is not luck. That is covenant. Luck has no covenant behind it. What you are walking into tonight is not chance, it is inheritance. Let's declare boldly, "Every enemy assigned to rise against you this season will be smitten before your face and will flee in seven directions." In the name of Jesus. I feel led to slow down here because I sense someone listening who has grown tired, not of God, but of fighting. You have declared war so many times that the phrase itself has started to feel hollow in your mouth. You are exhausted from believing. Church, I want to bring you comfort before I bring you more fire. Second Chronicles chapter 20 gives us Jehoshaphat's testimony for exactly this moment. Surrounded by three enemy armies with no natural strategy available, he received this word from the prophet Jahaziel, "Ye shall not need to fight in this battle. Set yourselves. Stand ye still and see the salvation of the Lord with you. Some of you have been swinging a sword God never asked you to pick up. Tonight, put it down. Some assignments are not cancelled by your efforts, they are cancelled by your position. Stand still. Watch. I decree over the weary warrior tonight your rest is not surrender. Your stillness is not defeat. God is fighting a battle right now that does not require your fists, only your faith. Be still and watch the ambushes in 2 Chronicles 20 unfold exactly the way they unfolded for Jehoshaphat. The enemy armies turned and destroyed each other and Israel simply gathered the spoil. I want to press further into this because there is a wrong kind of warfare mentality that has burned many believers out. The belief that every single day must be fought at maximum intensity or the enemy will win by default. That is not biblical warfare. That is anxiety wearing warfare language. Look at Judges chapter 7 where Gideon was told to reduce his army from 32,000 men to 300 before God would even release the victory. God deliberately stripped away human sufficiency so that when the victory came, Israel could never claim it was won by their own strength. Sometimes the reduction you are experiencing right now, fewer resources, fewer people standing with you, fewer options than you had last year, is not abandonment. It is God clearing the stage so the testimony afterward has only one possible explanation, him. I speak to somebody who feels reduced right now, reduced in support, reduced in finances, reduced in energy. I decree that this reduction is Gideon's 300, not defeat. What God is about to do through your little will require an explanation bigger than your little. Trumpets, pitchers, and lamps were the only weapons Gideon's army carried into that battle, and the enemy army fled in confusion before a single sword was drawn. Some of your battles will end the exact same way, not because of what you did, but because of the confusion God releases into the enemy's own camp the moment you obey a strange, seemingly foolish instruction in faith. Let the spirit of confusion be released now into every camp assembled against the people in this house. Let every strategy meeting held against your marriage, your finances, your health, or your children collapse into disagreement and chaos among the very forces that convened it. In the name of Jesus. Let every conspirator in that camp turn on the conspiracy itself. >> [music] >> The same way Judges chapter 7 records the Midianites turning their swords on one another in the dark. There is another layer to this warfare I must address because some assignments do not come through obvious enemies at all. They come disguised as blessing. Second Corinthians chapter 11 verse 14 warns us that Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light. Some of you have welcomed an assignment into your life because it arrived wearing the costume of opportunity, a relationship that looked like providence but drained your peace from day one, a business deal that looked like breakthrough but has since become a source of constant anxiety, a friendship that looked like divine connection but consistently pulls you away from prayer and toward compromise. I speak discernment over every disguised assignment in this house tonight. Let every counterfeit blessing be exposed for what it truly is in the name of Jesus. Let scales fall from eyes the way they fell from Saul's eyes on the road to Damascus so that what has been hidden in plain sight becomes undeniably clear. Let's pray because revelation without prayer is just information and information does not deliver anybody. Father, in the name of Jesus, we approach you tonight not as beggars but as a covenant people enforcing a victory already secured at Calvary. We thank you that the same blood that speaks better things than the blood of Abel, according to Hebrews chapter 12 verse 24, is speaking on our behalf right now. We ask you to move through this gathering with undeniable power in Jesus' name. I decree the restoration of destiny over every assignment that has stolen years, direction, or momentum from someone in this house. Jeremiah chapter 1 verse 12 says, "I will hasten my word to perform it." Every delayed destiny file come out of the enemy's archive and into active fulfillment right now in the name of Jesus. Every gift buried out of fear, every calling postponed out of disappointment, every dream shelved because of one too many failures resurrect tonight in the name of Jesus. I speak to family lines under coordinated assault where there has been strife with no natural explanation, where arguments erupt out of nowhere and escalate faster than the actual disagreement warrants, where love has grown cold between people who used to be close, I command the spirit behind that division to be exposed and expelled in the name of Jesus. Every evil altar established against a family represented in this house, whether by an ancestor's desperate bargain or an enemy's deliberate cause, catch fire and be reduced to nothing in the name of Jesus. Let every prodigal connected to this house receive a sudden, undeniable pull back toward home and toward God. Let the compassion of the father in Luke 15 chase down every wandering son and daughter tonight in the name of Jesus. Father, we bring marriages before you now because marriage is one of the most consistently targeted assignments in the body of Christ. The enemy understands that a united home produces authority. He cannot easily infiltrate. So, he attacks the unity before he attacks anything else. I break every spirit of division assigned to marriages represented here. Every third party, human or spiritual, working to separate what God has joined, I expose you and command you to flee. In the name of Jesus. For those waiting on marriage, I break every covenant of delay, whether spoken over your own life in a moment of bitterness or assigned by a spirit of rejection determined to keep you isolated. I decree that every hindering wall standing between you and your God-ordained connection is demolished tonight in the name of Jesus. Divine connection, locate your assigned person now. Let's move into finances. Because poverty is one of hell's favorite long-term assignments. Not always dramatic, just relentless, keeping a person perpetually one step behind, no matter how hard they work. I speak to every financial gate shut against someone in this house. Gates of promotion, gates of contracts, gates of favor with decision-makers who hold your breakthrough in their hands. Open now in the name of Jesus. Malachi chapter 3 verse 11 says, "And I will rebuke the devourer for your sake. I decree that every devouring spirit attached to your income, your business, your investments, your salary is rebuked and driven out right now in the name of Jesus. Every leaking pocket, every unexplained expense, every just in time to eat it all pattern where money enters and vanishes before it can establish you, I seal it shut in the name of Jesus. Let's pray for healing now because sickness is very often an assignment wearing a medical name. I am not dismissing medicine, go to your doctor, take your test, follow your treatment, but I am also declaring that some conditions have a spiritual root feeding a physical symptom. And until the root is addressed, the symptom keeps returning no matter how it is treated. I speak to every chronic condition represented in this house tonight. Every diagnosis that keeps circling back after treatment, every pain that migrates instead of leaving, every unexplained weakness be healed at the root in the name of Jesus. I want to speak specifically to somebody whose body has been the actual battlefield in this war, not a side effect of stress, but the direct target of an assignment. You have noticed that symptoms intensify around specific dates, specific conversations, or specific locations and you have quietly wondered if you are imagining the connection. You are not imagining it. Mark chapter 9 records a father bringing his son to Jesus describing a spirit that would cast the boy into fire and into water to destroy him, a physical manifestation with a clearly spiritual source. Jesus did not lecture the father about being dramatic. He addressed the spirit directly and the boy was healed from that hour. I address every spirit hiding behind a physical diagnosis in this house tonight. Come out and stay out in the name of Jesus. Exodus chapter 15 verse 26 declares, I am the Lord that healed thee. I decree that identity over every sick body in this house tonight. Every cell growing where it has no permission to grow, shrink and die in the name of Jesus. Every blocked organ be opened. Every irregular heartbeat be stabilized. Every sleepless night caused by pain be replaced with rest in the name of Jesus. I speak now to every covenant and cause that has kept an assignment alive across generations. Some battles you are fighting are not actually yours. You inherited them the day you were born into a particular bloodline. The same way you inherited a surname or a shape of your face. I decree tonight that every ancestral covenant currently working against you is terminated by the blood of Jesus. Every oath sworn at a shrine, every dedication made to a river, a tree or an ancestral spirit before you were old enough to consent is nullified right now in the name of Jesus. Whatever legal ground that covenant gave the enemy over your life is revoked completely. Let me press further into this. Because I sense someone here has spent years trying to fix a pattern with willpower alone, not realizing the pattern has legal roots older than their own decisions. You have tried harder, prayed longer, changed your habits and still the same result keeps repeating. The same financial ceiling, the same relationship collapse, the same health scare at the same age your parent experienced it. Exodus chapter 20 verse 5 speaks of iniquity being visited onto the third and fourth generation of them that hates me, but Galatians chapter 3 verse 13 answers that warning directly. Christ had redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us. The redemption is already purchased. Tonight we're not asking God to redeem you. We're announcing that the redemption already occurred and we're instructing every generational pattern to recognize the paperwork has changed. I call out every specific generational pattern hiding in this house tonight. Patterns of divorce, patterns of premature death, patterns of addiction, patterns of poverty despite hard work, patterns of chronic sickness that skip one generation and strike the next. I command every one of these patterns to break at the root in the name of Jesus. You are the generation the cycle stops with. Not your children, not your grandchildren, you. Let every idol worshiped by an ancestor that still holds silent influence over this family lose its grip completely. Let every name given to a child that carried a hidden dedication to a false god be spiritually renamed and recovered by the blood of Jesus tonight. Let every land, every property, every inheritance connected to an evil altar be cleansed and released fully into the hands of the rightful redeemed heirs in the name of Jesus. Let angelic intervention be released now because David's confidence in the middle of battle after battle was never in his own skill with a sling or a sword. It was in the reality that heaven's armies were engaged on his behalf. Psalm chapter 34 verse 7 says the angel of the Lord encamped round about them that fear him and delivereth them. I decree the mobilization of angelic hosts around every life represented in this gathering. Angels of provision move. Angels of protection take formation. Angels of confusion be dispatched into every camp plotting against this house. Somebody remember 2 Kings chapter 19 where Sennacherib's massive army surrounded Jerusalem with mockery and threats certain of victory and the Bible records simply that in one night the angel of the Lord went out and smote 185,000 men in the enemy's camp. One night, one angel, an army that looked unstoppable the evening before was gone by morning. I decree that same overnight intervention over every army assembled against you, every scheme, every coalition of opposition, every coordinated pressure receive a Sennacherib ending in the name of Jesus. Now, let's confront witchcraft directly because this title demands it. I speak to every coven, every gathering of darkness convened specifically to discuss your downfall scatter now in the name of Jesus. I command every mirror used to monitor your movements to crack. I command every image or effigy fashioned in your likeness for manipulation to burn completely. I command every familiar spirit assigned to track your steps, your conversations, your decisions to be blinded and disconnected in the name of Jesus. Let every arrow fired against you in the dream realm be returned to the sender by fire in the name of Jesus. Let every meal offered to you in a dream unknowingly received to be violently rejected and expelled [music] from your system now in the name of Jesus. Revelation chapter 12:11 declares that the brethren overcame by the blood of the lamb and the word of their testimony. >> [music] >> I decree that same overcoming grace over you tonight. You will not just survive this warfare. You will testify about it. Let's speak briefly to time and virtue because assignments are designed to drain more than money and health. They drain the strength required to keep believing. Some of you have given so much of yourselves in prayer, in service, in patience with people who never reciprocated it that you feel like an empty container tonight. I speak to that depletion. Be refilled in the name of Jesus. Isaiah chapter 40:31 promises they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength. They shall mount up with wings as eagles. I decree renewed strength over every exhausted believer in this house tonight. I speak to time itself. Every hour, every month, every year the enemy has stolen through delay, sickness, destruction, or wrong relationships. I command the supernatural compression of time to bring you swiftly to where you were always meant to be in the name of Jesus. Habakkuk chapter 2:3 assures us though it tarry wait for it because it will surely come. It will not tarry. The tarrying is over tonight. Father, we ask now for divine preservation over every life represented here. Preservation of body, mind, marriage, destiny, and testimony. Psalm chapter 91, though we will not read every verse tonight, gives us this anchor in verse 11. For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. I decree that charge activated over you right now in the name of Jesus. No plague shall come near your dwelling. No pestilence shall touch your household. No sudden calamity shall find its target in your family. Let's release specific words now because a service like this must not end in generalities. There is someone on this call who has been fighting a legal battle for years feeling like the truth simply does not matter in that courtroom. God says the truth is about to matter. A witness or piece of evidence you did not expect is coming forward. There is a man whose business partner has been quietly undermining him for months. Pay closer attention to recent financial records. Something does not add up and you already sense it. Somebody has a child who suddenly changed, became withdrawn, angry, secretive, and you cannot explain the shift. There is a specific influence, possibly a friendship, that entered during this season. Address it directly and prayerfully rather than assuming it will resolve on its own. I see someone who has had the same dream repeatedly being chased by an unseen figure, never able to see its face. That dream ends tonight. It was assigned. It was not random. Somebody has been experiencing sudden sharp pain in a specific part of the body that comes and goes without warning. Get it checked medically, but also know that a spiritual root is being addressed tonight as well. There is a woman whose mother-in-law has spoken words over her marriage that she has never repeated to anyone, words that still echo in her mind during arguments. Those words lose their power tonight in the name of Jesus. I see a delayed visa or travel document. Movement is coming on that file within this season. Do not make alternate plans yet. Somebody's finances took a specific hit around the same time every year, almost calendar-like in its consistency. That cycle is broken tonight in the name of Jesus. There is a man who has quietly resented his father for a wound from decades ago and has never said it out loud to anyone. Release that resentment tonight, even privately in prayer, and watch your own health and finances shift. I see someone preparing for an interview or exam who is more prepared than they believe. Fear of failure is louder than the truth about your preparation. Silence that fear tonight. Somebody has a relative who practices something spiritually dangerous, and you have unknowingly received gifts, food, or money from that relative. I decree spiritual cleansing over every such transaction in the name of Jesus. There is a minister listening tonight wounded by betrayal within their own ministry team, questioning whether trust is even possible in ministry anymore. God says do not let the wound close your gift. Grieve it, then heal, then trust again carefully, but again, somebody has been quietly carrying suicidal thoughts, >> [music] >> ashamed to voice them even in prayer. I speak life over you right now in the name of Jesus. That thought is not your own, it is a foreign voice, and it has no legal right to dictate your future. Reach out to someone tonight, a pastor, a counselor, a trusted friend. You are not required to carry this silently. I see someone whose sibling relationship has been fractured for years over an inheritance dispute or an old betrayal never fully addressed. Reconciliation is being made available this season, but it will require you to speak first. There is a person on this call who keeps sabotaging good opportunities right before they succeed. Quitting jobs on the verge of promotion, ending relationships right before commitment, abandoning projects right before completion. This is a documented pattern, not coincidence. I break the spirit of self-sabotage over your life tonight in the name of Jesus. Somebody's spouse has been secretly struggling with a financial addiction, gambling, reckless spending, or hidden debt. Truth is coming to the surface soon. When it does, respond with wisdom, not only emotion. I see a young woman who was told by a doctor that conceiving naturally would be extremely difficult. I decree a testimony that defies that report in the name of Jesus. Genesis chapter 18:14 asks the question that answers itself, "Is anything too hard for the Lord?" Let's return to full declaration now, because this house has permission to be loud about what belongs to it. Every scattered destiny, gather now in the name of Jesus. Every disconnected divine connection, reconnect in the name of Jesus. Every silenced gift, speak again in the name of Jesus. Every closed door assigned to stay closed until you gave up, open now in the name of Jesus. I decree total defeat over every enemy that rose against this house tonight. Psalm chapter 35:1 becomes our prayer. Plead my cause, oh Lord, with them that strive with me. Fight against them that fight against me. Father, take up your own case against everyone and everything fighting what you have already blessed. Let every enemy that has been mocking your delay be silenced by your sudden testimony. Let every voice that said it will never happen for you choke on the news of your breakthrough. Let every gathering that celebrated your setback be interrupted by reports of your comeback. I decree that from tonight, you carry a reputation in the spirit realm as someone the enemy no longer wants to test. Let every principality that previously underestimated your prayer life recalibrate its entire strategy because of what happened in this room tonight. I want to speak one more time to the person who has been keeping score, counting how many times they have prayed this exact before, wondering privately if tonight will be any different from the last 10 times they declared war and nothing visibly changed. I understand that weariness, and I will not insult it by pretending it isn't real. But Galatians chapter 6:9 gives us the promise that anchors persistent warfare, "And let us not be weary in well doing, for in due season we shall reap if we faint not." The word if matters here. The reaping is conditional, not on the intensity of one single prayer, but on your refusal to quit believing between now and the due season. Some of you are one declaration away from the due season arriving. >> [music] >> Do not let tonight be the night you stopped right before the harvest. I decree over every discouraged intercessor in this house, your consistency has not been wasted. Every midnight prayer that seemed to disappear into silence was recorded. Revelation chapter 5:8 describes the prayers of the saints as incense in golden vials before the throne. Nothing you have prayed has evaporated into nothing. It has been collecting in heaven, and tonight some of those collected prayers are being answered all at once in a single overwhelming release in the name of Jesus. Father, we thank you that salvation, deliverance, and victory belong to you alone, and that your blessing rest permanently on your people. Let that blessing remain upon every family, every marriage, every business, every ministry represented here. Not for a season, but as an ongoing inheritance in the name of Jesus. I want to close the way war councils have always closed, not in uncertainty, but in a declaration of victory before the smoke has even cleared. Somebody stand to your feet right now. Lift your voice and declare with everything in you, "Every demonic assignment against me is canceled. Not weakened, not delayed. Canceled fully, finally, completely in the name of Jesus Christ." Say it again louder, like you actually believe the war is already over. It is canceled. Father, we thank you for tonight. We thank you that we did not gather to beg for a victory that might come someday, but to enforce a victory already secured 2,000 years ago at an empty tomb. Let this word not return to you void, according to Isaiah 55 verse 11, but let it accomplish exactly what you sent it to accomplish in every life it has touched tonight. Go from this place carrying the confidence of a soldier who already read the ending of the war and knows which side wins. Every assignment against you, named or unnamed, known or unknown, old or new, is canceled tonight in the matchless unshakable victorious name of Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen. And amen.
